reconstruction_summary: Reproduced V1 (the agent's recommended 'ship V1' variant): KS yaw_rate = (v/L)*tan(delta) minus a per-segment yaw-gyro bias fitted as the mean of (ks_pred - meas) on |delta|<0.01 rad rows, exactly as agent's tools/step4_run_st_upgrade.py computes it.
notes: V1 is KS (v/L)*tan(delta) minus a per-segment constant equal to the mean (ks_pred - meas) over straight rows (|delta|<0.01 rad); L is the openpilot wheelbase per platform (2.875 m Mach-E, 3.70 m F-150 Lightning). Coefficients are not stored — they are recomputed from each sim.csv exactly as the agent's step4_run_st_upgrade.py does (per __source__ group).
